This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Bin Essada/Legends|Bin Essada]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Near-Human]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their light sensitive<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> [[Color/Legends|pink]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Bin Essada/Legends|Bin Essada]],<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> served as the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] [[Moff/Legends|governor]] of the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> in the [[1978]]<ref name="SWYouTube">{{ThisWeek|2Ev-DKh1i_M|Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser News, The Mandalorian Comes to Emoji Blitz, and More!|sw_url=video/disneyxd-star-wars-galactic-starcruiser-news-the-mandalorian-comes-to-emoji-blitz-and-more}}</ref> novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" />
